findings.description: Fernando Suarez Franco married Maria de Jesus Ramirez on 11 November 1891 at the parish of the Inmaculada Concepción, Aguadas, Caldas, Colombia; the entry indexes him as Fernando Franco, son of Manuela Franco, with no father named.

details.place: Inmaculada Concepción, Aguadas, Aguadas, Caldas, Colombia

supporting_sources: ark:/61903/1:1:QG2B-LVHQ — deciding marriage record, INDEX (Colombia, registros parroquiales y diocesanos, 1576-2019): Fernando Franco married Maria de Jesus Ramirez, 11 Nov 1891; the record's own event place is Inmaculada Concepción, Aguadas, Aguadas, Caldas, Colombia; groom's mother Manuela Franco named, no father

ark:/61903/1:1:6DDW-L7XF — corroborating, INDEX: Fernando Suárez as father in daughter Julia Rosa's 21 Jun 1896 Caramanta baptism, already attached to tree person GZ6S-8MW; its index names his parents Juan de Dios Suárez and Manuela Franco and the mother María's parents Luís Ramírez and Juana Henao, so the maternal grandparents match the 1891 bride's parents exactly and the paternal pair supplies the father the marriage index omitted — tying the tree's Fernando and his wife to the marriage record on indexes alone

findings.description: The bride, Maria Jesus Ramirez Henao, was the daughter of Luis Ramirez and Juana Henao.
